text:
ellie (CS): Heads-up — we have ~40 onboarding tenants in eu-west affected by embedding index jobs returning 503s. Putting a draft customer status below for feedback; need credits decision and who can host office hours.
ellie (CS): DRAFT to affected tenants: 

Hi — we’re investigating an error impacting indexing for some onboarding projects in the EU region. Our engineers have identified a throttling regression and we’re rolling a mitigation now. We’ll share an ETA for full recovery in 60 minutes. We’re offering a credit for impacted ingestion attempts and a live office hours session to help re-run any failed imports. Reply if you want us to re-run the job or join office hours.

— Redwood CS

maya (Account Lead): Thanks. Can we tier credits by renewal risk? I’d like to offer higher-touch customers more proactive re-ingest + dedicated slot for re-runs.
ben (CS Ops): I can assemble affected tenant list with renewal tier, product usage, and contact owner by EOD. Suggest credit = min(10% monthly committed + ingestion retry costs, $500) for standard. Premium customers: $1k + re-ingest support.
tom (Infra): quick update from infra — we’ve traced the 503s to a rate-limiter threshold regression after the autoscaler bump. Rolled a hotfix to revert that limiter config at 15:03 UTC; rolling traffic back. We expect reduced 503s within 3–7 minutes. Monitoring now.
raj (Eng-ML): Follow-up — some jobs failed mid-chunk and will need resume logic. We have a resume patch ready to backfill missing chunks; can be scheduled as a backfill run. That’s separate from re-ingest where customers want full re-run.
ellie (CS): Good. For comms: we should separate two asks to customers: 1) immediate status + expected ETA and credit offer; 2) opt-in: re-run vs backfill vs manual help. Want to avoid confusing tech detail.
maya (Account Lead): Agreed. I'll approve the standard credit band for renewals < $50k. For renewal-risked accounts (tier A), suggest approving $1k and priority office hours. Approve now?
ben (CS Ops): Approve for me on the standard band. I'll create a templated reply per tenant with variables: tenant name, contact, tier, suggested credit, option buttons (re-run/backfill/manual). Could use the support portal macros.
ellie (CS): @tom can infra confirm recovery and leave signal to us when all indexing queues are back to nominal? I’ll hold outbound until we have a positive signal or 60m passes.
tom (Infra): Will do. Posting a small check here when 503 rate drops below 0.5% for 5 minutes.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-22-47 created for eu-west indexer 503 spike — priority P2.
raj (Eng-ML): If we need to schedule backfills, we'll prioritize tier A then B. I’ll estimate per-tenant backfill time after I get the tenant dataset sizes from ben.
ben (CS Ops): I’ll push the tenant list to the shared sheet and add a "re-run requested" flag. Link: https://redwood.app/sheets/incident-reingest-eu (private)
ellie (CS): Good work. Next steps: ben to share list + per-tenant recommended credit, maya to confirm tier A approvals for $1k, tom to flag when recovery is green, raj to estimate backfill times. I'll draft the final outbound and run it by maya before sending.
maya (Account Lead): Also propose a one-hour office hours slot at 16:00 UTC. I can host with a solutions engineer. Anyone else able to attend?
ben (CS Ops): I can join and bring runbooks for re-ingest.
tom (Infra): I’ll standby in case we need to escalate or kick manual replays.
ellie (CS): Thanks team. If anyone wants to add wording to the outbound, drop snippets here. Otherwise I’ll send a customer-safe status update once tom confirms.
ellie (CS): small suggested short note to include in email subject: "Redwood status: indexing interruptions for EU onboarding — actionable options inside"
